fusions.name: Over the Rim
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow over the shield's rim that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Slit
fusions.desc: Draws for 1 second behind the shield, then looses 4 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 10 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Pavise Battery
fusions.desc: Spends 1 second planting a standing shield with an arrow slit. It holds for 15 seconds and looses an arrow at an enemy within 6 tiles every 1.5 seconds, each dealing 5 damage.

fusions.name: Drawn by Every Blow
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
